lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal rows of high-luminance white spots are visible posterior to the fifth gill slit, with the most prominent spots clustered in the mid-flank region forming a semi-regular grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows, creating a distinct checkerboard appearance where high-intensity blobs serve as nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a high-luminance highlights on the dorsal edge and a significant shadow gradient on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains approximately 6-8 distinct high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily along the posterior half and distal margin of the fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a significantly higher spatial density of smaller, fine-grained high-luminance spots compared to the larger macro-blobs found on the lateral flank.
